decides_falsified_if: the decomposition is not additive, or a strictly one-sided construction produces a non-negligible component on the wrong side, or the sign agreement is no better than chance
decides_verified_if: l-ERT equals l+-ERT plus l--ERT to below 1e-9 on every produced value for all three scores
on a strictly over-covering construction the positive part has a 95% CI above 0.025 and the negative part is below 0.01, and symmetrically for a strictly under-covering one
on the two-sided construction both parts are strictly positive
sign(h(x) - (1-alpha)) agrees with sign(p(x) - (1-alpha)) on more than 75% of points, with p(x) known in closed form
the exactly-conditional control shows neither component above 0.01

quantifiers.scale: 50,000 test points per seed, ten seeds

statement: The metrics decompose conditional coverage error into asymmetric l+-ERT and l--ERT components, separating unnecessary conservatism from excessive aggressiveness.
would_not_count: hand-built prediction vectors instead of prediction sets from a conformal construction
a construction whose miscoverage is a constant marginal shift, where no localisation is being tested
